newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius and Kuwait sign tax avoidance treaty.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius and Kuwait sign tax avoidance treaty.

text.p: Kuwait and the Indian Ocean island of Mauritius on Monday signed a double taxation avoidance (DTA) agreement aiming at boosting cross-border investments between the two countries, government officials said.

"The Agreement also provides for reduced taxation at source or exemption on various sources of income and this should be an added incentive for an increase in cross border activities," Mauritian Finance Minister Vasant Bunwaree said.
"I am confident that investors from both our countries will avail themselves of the new opportunities that will arise, for the mutual development of our countries," Bunwaree added.
The DTA treaty with Kuwait adds to the some 20 others Mauritius has already signed for its offshore sector.
An overwhelming majority of business in the Mauritian offshore sector has investments concentrated in India, officials of the Mauritius Offshore Business Activities Authority said.
Some 5,000 firms are registered in the Mauritian offshore sector, managing 62 billion rupees ($3.1 billion) in funds.
